place.name: Pirámide de Mayo
place.description: The Pirámide de Mayo (Spanish pronunciation: [piˈɾamiðe ðe ˈmaʝo]; English: Pyramid of May), located at the hub of the Plaza de Mayo, is the oldest national monument in the city of Buenos Aires. Its construction was ordered in 1811 by the Primera Junta to celebrate the first anniversary of the May Revolution.
